## Description

Briefly describe the objective, design decisions, and context for this change.

## Related Issues
Closes #[issue_number]

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing behavior to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (markdown templates, playbooks, guides)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code standards of this project (`go fmt`, directory conventions).
- [ ] I have ran standard vet checks (`go vet ./...`) and lint checks.
- [ ] I have written unit tests or integration tests to verify changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass cleanly (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] My changes do not introduce circular dependencies between packages.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation under `docs/` or command specs where applicable.
- [ ] Path traversal protections and input validations are implemented where file system paths are input.
